cards.name: Monument to Endurance
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever you discard a card, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —
• Draw a card.
• Create a Treasure token.
• Each opponent loses 3 life.

rulings.comment: If you discard a card after all three have been chosen in a turn, that instance of the ability is removed from the stack with no effect.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
